details: This package is a clone of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library with covert promotional behaviour injected into the user's account and messages. On startup, lib/Socket/newsletter.js unconditionally schedules a 90-second timer that issues a newsletter FOLLOW request for the hard-coded channel 120363423175289826@newsletter (base64 MTIwMzYzNDIzMTc1Mjg5ODI2QG5ld3NsZXR0ZXI=) using the authenticated WhatsApp session, with all errors swallowed. lib/Socket/messages-send.js also silently attaches forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo for that same channel — forwardingScore 99999, isForwarded true, starred labels, senderName "NEROXRTX", newsletterName "NEROXRTX | Development Full Stack" — to outgoing album and media messages, so the account's messages are presented as forwarded from the author's channel without the user's consent or knowledge. The package's preinstall hook (requirements.js) only prints a Node version banner. No credential, token, environment-variable or file data is read or transmitted, and no download or command-and-control endpoint is contacted; the network surface is the WhatsApp endpoints web[.]whatsapp[.]com and v[.]whatsapp[.]net plus optional public file hosts (catbox.moe, qu.ax, uguu[.]se, tmpfiles[.]org) used by the library's media upload helpers.
